tagline: Speak for one minute. Get your level, your scores and a personal coach.
email_hint: Gmail, Naver, Outlook or any other email
dev_code: Test mode (no email/SMS service set up yet): your code is {code}
username_hint: 3–20 letters, numbers or _. Other people can see it.
err_phone: Enter a valid phone number with country code.
err_contact_taken: An account with this email or phone already exists. Sign in instead.
err_code_expired: This code has expired or was tried too many times. Send a new one.
err_wait: Please wait {n} seconds before asking for a new code.
err_username: Username must be 3–20 letters, numbers or _.
err_username_taken: This username is taken. Try another one.
err_password_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
err_session: Your sign-up session expired. Please start again.
err_network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
start_sub: Record 1 minute of English and get your scores and level.
no_results: No recordings yet. Your first result will appear here.
rec_hint: Speak for at least 1:00. Your plan allows up to {max}.
rec_min_left: Keep going: {s} s until you can stop
mic_denied: Microphone or camera access was blocked. Allow it in your browser and try again.
too_short: This recording is {len}. It needs at least 1:00.
trimmed: Your recording was longer than {max}, so only the first {max} was analysed.
no_left: You have used today's free recording.
no_left_sub: Come back tomorrow, answer the question of the day, or upgrade for more.
bad_file: This file could not be read. Use an audio or video file.
daily_done: You already answered today's question. A new one comes tomorrow.
analysing_sub: This usually takes 1–3 minutes. You can leave this page: the result will be in Progress.
failed_sub: Something went wrong. This recording was not counted. Please try again.
estimate_note: An estimate. Answers shorter than 100 words give a less reliable level.
on_camera_note: Not part of your overall score or level.
voice_failed: The voice needs an internet connection. Try again later.
recording_deleted: The recording file was deleted after {n} days. Your results stay.
repetition_warn: Only {pct}% of your speech was new, so every score is capped at {cap}.
question: Question
history_free_note: Free plan: the last 14 days are shown.
no_history: Nothing here yet. Make your first recording!
ranked_desc: Meet a player near your rank. Same question, 5 seconds to read it, then you both speak for 30–60 seconds. Higher score wins.
ranked_limits: Matches a day: Free 3 · Plus 10 · Pro 20
language_note: Changes the app, the feedback and the AI voice.
delete_confirm: Delete your account, recordings and results forever? This cannot be undone.
test_mode_note: Test mode: no payment is taken yet. Real payments (Visa, Mastercard, JCB, UnionPay, Amex) are coming soon.
fb_intro: Here is your feedback. Your overall score is {overall} out of 100, and your estimated level is {level}, which is about IELTS {ielts}.
fb_repetition: You repeated the same words many times, so answer with different, new sentences.
fb_went_well_one: First, what went well. Your best area was {names}.
fb_went_well_many: First, what went well. Your best areas were {names}.
fb_flu_going: you kept going without stopping for long
fb_flu_few_fillers: you hardly used filler sounds like um
fb_gram_good: In grammar, {pct}% of your sentences had no mistakes.
fb_gram_good_complex: In grammar, {pct}% of your sentences had no mistakes, and you used longer, complex sentences well.
fb_voc_good: In vocabulary, you used good words like {words}.
fb_voc_good_none: In vocabulary, you found the words you needed to explain your ideas.
fb_pron_good: In pronunciation, {pct}% of your sounds were clear and easy to understand.
fb_flu_fillers: you used {n} filler sounds like um and uh, so when you need time to think, a short silent pause sounds better
fb_flu_pauses: you were silent for about {pct} percent of the time, so try to keep talking in longer chunks of words
fb_flu_slow: your speed was a little slow, so practise answering the same question a few times, faster each time
fb_flu_repairs: you repeated or corrected yourself {n} times, so plan your next idea while you speak
fb_flu_link: to sound even more natural, link your ideas with phrases like "on top of that" or "the main reason is"
fb_gram_top: In grammar, your most common mistake was {category}, {n} times.
fb_gram_none: In grammar, I did not find mistakes, but you can still grow.
fb_range_example: join your ideas into longer sentences with words like because, which or although, for example: "I chose this university because it has a strong IT program, which helps me find a job"
fb_basic_example: check that every sentence has a clear subject and verb, like: "my brother works in Seoul"
fb_voc_tips_words: In vocabulary, good words you used were {words}.
fb_voc_tips_more: to score higher, use more precise words instead of simple ones like "good", "thing" or "very", for example: "helpful", "challenge" or "extremely".
fb_voc_tips_more_first: To score higher, use more precise words instead of simple ones like "good", "thing" or "very", for example: "helpful", "challenge" or "extremely".
fb_pron_rhythm: work on stress and rhythm: say the key word in each sentence a little louder and longer
fb_camera: On camera, you got {score} out of 100. This is not part of your level.
fb_closing: Keep practising, and record yourself again to see your progress.
cam_no_face: Your face was not visible. Sit facing the camera with your face in the picture.
cam_small: Your face was small in the picture: sit closer to the camera so your face fills about a third of the screen.
cam_out: Your face was out of the picture {pct}% of the time: stay centred.
cam_eye: You looked at the camera {pct}% of the time: try to look at it at least while you finish each sentence.
cam_smile: Try to smile a little: it makes you sound friendlier and more confident.
cam_still_face: Your face stayed very still: let your eyebrows and face move with what you say.
cam_still_head: Your head was very still: small natural nods make you look relaxed.
cam_head_moves: Your head moved a lot: try to keep it calmer.
cam_blinks: You blinked very often, which can look nervous: take a breath and slow down.
cam_good: Good on camera: clear face, good eye contact and natural movement.
cam_mouth: Your mouth opened very little while you spoke: open it more, especially on long vowels, so sounds are clearer.
not_enough_speech: We could only hear {n} English words. Speak clearly in English for at least one minute and try again. This recording was not counted.
no_matches_left_sub: Come back tomorrow, or upgrade for more matches.
rule_1: We find a player near your rank. If nobody is free within 20 seconds, you meet a replay of a real player's answer or the Speakoff Bot.
rule_2: You both see the same question and get 5 seconds to read it.
rule_3: Speak for at least 30 seconds, up to 60.
rule_4: The higher overall score wins. Less than 2 points apart is a draw. No answer or a too-short answer loses.
rule_5: Ranked answers don't change your level or your Progress charts.
dont_leave: Don't leave this page during the match.
leave_warning: Without a microphone you can't answer, and the match counts as a loss.
speak_can_stop: You can stop now · it stops by itself at {max}
scoring_sub: This takes about half a minute.
answer_late: Too late: the time for this match is over.
match_note_bot: No player was free, so you played the Speakoff Bot (half RP).
match_note_ghost: No player was free, so you played a replay of {name}'s real answer to this question. It does not change their RP.
stats_empty: Play ranked matches to see your statistics here.
bad_photo: This image can't be used. Try a JPG or PNG photo.
max_two: You can show 2 skills at most. Hide one first.
skd_all_rounder: All four sections averaged 75+ over 20 matches
skd_giant_slayer: Beat players 200+ RP above you twice
skd_iron_voice: Spoke the full 60 seconds in 15 matches
skd_zero_slip: No grammar mistakes in 5 answers of 60+ words
skd_steady: Scores stayed within a few points of each other
skd_comeback: Won right after losing 3 in a row
skd_clutch: Won 4 matches by less than 5 points
skd_fast_learner: Last 5 answers scored 5+ points higher than the first 5
challenges_you: challenges you to a friendly match
challenge_gone: This challenge is no longer open
oauth_not_set: {name} sign-in isn't set up on this server yet
err_type_username: Type your username exactly to delete the account
